results.title: Genuine redundancy payments | Australian Taxation Office
results.description:
# Genuine redundancy payments
## On this page
- [Genuine redundancy](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/jobs-and-employment-types/working-as-an-employee/leaving-your-job/genuine-redundancy-payments#ato-Genuineredundancy)
- [Non-genuine redundancy](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/jobs-and-employment-types/working-as-an-employee/leaving-your-job/genuine-redundancy-payments#ato-Nongenuineredundancy)
- [Amounts you include from a genuine redundancy](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/jobs-and-employment-types/working-as-an-employee/leaving-your-job/genuine-redundancy-payments#ato-Amountsyouincludefromagenuineredundancy)
- [Amounts you exclude from a genuine redundancy](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/jobs-and-employment-types/working-as-an-employee/leaving-your-job/genuine-redundancy-payments#ato-Amountsyouexcludefromagenuineredundancy)

## Genuine redundancy
- [tax-free up to a limit](https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/key-superannuation-rates-and-thresholds/employment-termination-payments#ato-Taxfreepartofgenuineredundancyandearlyretirementschemepayments) depending on your years of service
- concessionally [taxed as an employment termination payment (ETP)](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/jobs-and-employment-types/working-as-an-employee/leaving-your-job/how-etp-components-are-taxed) above your tax-free limit
- taxed at your usual [marginal tax rate](https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/tax-rates-australian-residents) for any amount above [certain caps](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/hiring-and-paying-your-workers/engaging-a-worker/when-a-worker-leaves-your-business/taxation-of-termination-payments/applying-the-etp-caps).

## Non-genuine redundancy
You pay tax on a non-genuine redundancy as part of your [ETP](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/jobs-and-employment-types/working-as-an-employee/leaving-your-job/employment-termination-payments-for-employees). This means you generally pay tax at a lower rate than your normal income, if the payment doesn't exceed [certain caps](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/hiring-and-paying-your-workers/engaging-a-worker/when-a-worker-leaves-your-business/taxation-of-termination-payments/applying-the-etp-caps).

## Amounts you include from a genuine redundancy
- severance payment of a number of weeks' pay for each year of service
